name: securereel-dit
description: 免费开源的摄影机素材拷贝与校验工具：多目标拷贝、xxHash64 复核、ASC MHL、不可变报告。

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && test ! -f out/main/verify.js && sh scripts/dist-mac.sh
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && test ! -f out/main/verify.js && sh scripts/dist-win.sh
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:node && npm run type-check:web
scripts.verify:pipeline: rm -rf out && SECUREREEL_VERIFY=1 electron-vite build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -u NODE_OPTIONS electron out/main/verify.js --no-sandbox
scripts.verify:app: rm -rf out && electron-vite build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -u NODE_OPTIONS SECUREREEL_SMOKE_SCREENSHOT=.verify-output/app.png electron out/main/index.js --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --user-data-dir=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/securereel-smoke
scripts.verify: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run verify:pipeline && npm run verify:app
